title: Fleet envelope (hosts channel, protocol v1)
description: Identical to the server channel's envelope (FLEET.md §5). Every WebSocket message on /api/fleet/host is one UTF-8 JSON text frame (max 1 MiB). The payload is validated separately, against messages/<type>.json.

ts.description: sender clock, ms since Unix epoch

ref.description: id of the message this answers

epoch.description: not used on the hosts channel
